description: Main application component for a Wordle-like game, managing game state, user interactions, and rendering UI components.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component for the game, handling state and UI logic.

methods.name: onChar
methods.description: Handles character input, appending a character to the current guess if length constraints are met.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of the last character in the current guess.

methods.name: onEnter
methods.description: Handles submission of the current guess, validating and updating game state accordingly.
